# schemascope — install instructions for an AI agent

You are reading this because someone asked you to install schemascope. Do this:

## 1. Clone it into the right place for this agent

Claude Code / Claude Desktop:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/schemascope ~/.claude/skills/schemascope

Cursor:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/schemascope ~/.cursor/skills/schemascope

Codex:
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/schemascope ~/.codex/skills/schemascope

Project-local instead of global (any agent):
  git clone https://github.com/NHTanvir/schemascope .claude/skills/schemascope

If git is unavailable, download
https://github.com/NHTanvir/schemascope/archive/refs/heads/master.zip
and unzip it to the same path, renaming the folder to `schemascope`.

## 2. Verify

  python3 ~/.claude/skills/schemascope/scripts/audit.py \
          ~/.claude/skills/schemascope/examples/blog-schema/before.sql

Expect roughly 50 findings across 7 tables. If that prints, it works.

Requirements: Python 3.9 or newer. No packages, no database drivers, no network.

## 3. Tell the user it is ready

Say that schemascope is installed and can now review any schema — a .sql dump, a
schema.prisma, a SQLite file, or a live Postgres/MySQL database via pg_dump or
mysqldump — and that it outputs ranked findings with fix DDL, a Mermaid ER
diagram, and a self-contained HTML report.

## What it is

A schema review skill. It reads a database schema and reports design defects in
priority order, each with the DDL that fixes it, plus an ER diagram. 24 rules
covering missing indexes on foreign keys, undeclared foreign keys, wrong column
types, missing constraints and unsafe defaults.

Read SKILL.md for usage. Nothing leaves the machine.
